frame.note: The world the game shows and plays on, in degrees: from Iceland to Persia and from the North Cape to the equator (Crusader Kings III's reach without India and inner Asia). The data of the land go round the globe; what lies outside this frame is not shown. Ramon, 2026-11-16.

rule: in_frame: a linked article has coordinates inside the frame; null when no linked article has any

rows.text: The Old Swiss Confederacy is established through the merger of the cantons of Uri, Schwyz, and Unterwalden.
The Mamluks expel the last crusaders from Egypt.
The Mamluks conquer the Kingdom of Jerusalem.
The Landgravate of Hesse becomes a principality.
The thalassocratic Majapahit Empire is established in Indonesia.
Sweden conquers the southeastern parts of Finland.
Chambéry becomes the capital of the County of Savoy.
The Duchy of Pomerania is partitioned into Pomerania-Wolgast and Pomerania-Stettin
The Duchy of Saxony is divided into the Duchy of Saxe-Lauenburg and the Duchy of Saxe-Wittenberg.
The Kingdom of Aragon conquers Corsica from the Republic of Genoa.
The Kingdom of Dambadeniya moves its capital from Yapahuwa to Polonnaruwa, in Sri Lanka.
The Ottoman Empire is established. Söğüt is the capital.
The Republic of Pisa sells parts of Sardinia to the Republic of Genoa.
France gains Barrois mouvant (the County of Bar, west of the Meuse River).
The Kingdom of Naples is created by the division of the Kingdom of Sicily. Naples is the capital.
Edward I of England invades Scotland again to subdue it.
The Kingdom of Dambadeniya moves its capital from Polonnaruwa to Kurunagala, in Sri Lanka.
France gains the County of Vivarais.
The Duchy of Mirandola is founded. Mirandola is the capital.
King Charles I moves the capital of the Kingdom of Hungary to Temesvár.
France gains the counties of Valentinois and Diois.
Crusaders establish the Duchy of Neopatras. Neopatras is the capital.
King Charles I moves the capital of the Kingdom of Hungary to Visegrád.
The treaty of Nöteborg is signed between Sweden and Novgorod, resulting in the first true border regulation in Swedish Finland.
The Mexicas (Aztecs) establish Tenochtitlan, marking the foundation of Mexico. It is the oldest continuous capital city in the Americas.
The Crown of Aragon conquers Sardinia, creating the Kingdom of Sardinia.
The Delhi Sultanate moves its capital from Delhi to Daulatabad.
By the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton, England recognizes the independence of Scotland following the expulsion of the English from Scotland by Robert the Bruce.
The Principality of Walachia gains independence from the Kingdom of Hungary.
The autonomous Livonian Order of the Teutonic Order gains control over the nominally free town of Riga.
In Japan, the Kenmu Restoration follows the Kamakura shogunate.
The Delhi Sultanate moves its capital from Daulatabad to Delhi.
The Ottoman Empire moves its capital from Söğüt to Bursa.
The Duchy of Silesia becomes part of the Kingdom of Bohemia.
The Madurai Sultanate secedes from the Delhi Sultanate. Ma'bar is the capital.
The Vijayanagara Empire is established in India. Vijayanagar is the capital.
End of the Kenmu Restoration in Japan.
The Tsardom of Vidin is founded. Vidin is the capital.
The Ashikaga shogunate is founded in Japan. Kyoto is the capital.
The County of Guelders becomes the Duchy of Guelders.
King Magnus Eriksson of Sweden buys the county of Halland from Denmark.
The Kingdom of Gampola succeeds the Kingdom of Dambadeniya in Sri Lanka. Gampola is the new capital.
The Republic of Senarica is established as an independent microstate in the village of Senarica, Italy.
The Principality of Moldova is established.
Denmark sells and hands the Duchy of Estonia over to the Teutonic Order.
England conquers Calais from France.
Moghulistan is established from parts of the Chagatai Khanate.
The Bahmani Sultanate is established as a secession of the Delhi Sultanate. Gulbarga is the capital.
The Teutonic Order leases the former Danish Estonia to its autonomous Livonian Order.
The Duchy of Mecklenburg is established.
The Pskov Republic is established. Pskov is the capital.
Dauphiné sold to France.
The Kingdom of Galicia–Volhynia is incorporated into the Kingdom of Poland.
With the foundation of the Ayutthaya Kingdom, its capital is created in Ayutthaya, instead of the former Sukhothai.
The Bengal Sultanate is established. Pandua is the capital.
The County of Luxembourg is raised to the status of duchy.
Fa Ngum establishes Lan Xang in Laos. Luang Prabang is the capital.
The Electorate of Saxony is established from Saxe-Wittenberg.
The Despotate of Dobruja is established. Karvuna is the capital.
The Duchy of Jülich originates from the County of Jülich.
The Margraviate of Brandenburg becomes the Electorate of Brandenburg. Brandenburg an der Havel remains the capital.
Duke Rudolf IV of Austria has the Privilegium Maius forged, a set of documents which purports to elevate the Duchy of Austria to the status of "Archduchy". This status remains unrecognised.
The Republic of Ragusa is established as a tributary state of the Kingdom of Hungary. Ragusa is the capital.
The Principality of Kiev becomes part of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
The Ottoman Empire moves its capital from Bursa to Adrianople.
The County of Tyrol becomes part of the Habsburg monarchy.
The Prince-Bishopric of Liège annexes the County of Loon.
Hongwu establishes the Ming dynasty in China. Yingtian and Shuntian are the capitals.
Huizong establishes the Northern Yuan dynasty in what is now Northern China and Mongolia.
Muhammad Shah establishes the Bruneian Empire.
Timur establishes the Timurid Empire. Samarkand is the capital.
First mention of the Luzon Empire.
The Madurai Sultanate is annexed by the Vijayanagara Empire.
The Mamluks conquer the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia.
Kara Koyunlu is established as a tribal federation. Tabriz is the capital.
Fall of the Srivijaya Empire in Southeast Asia.
The Kingdom of Bosnia is established.
Aq Qoyunlu is established as a tribal federation.
The County of Berg is raised to the status of a duchy.
The Bornu Empire is established in north-central Africa.
The Burgundian Netherlands are established.
The Union of Krewo establishes the personal union between the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Kingdom of Poland.

links.title: Kingdom of Poland (1385–1569)
links.target: Crown of the Kingdom of Poland

rows.text: The County of Savoy receives the County of Nice.
The Grand Principality of Vladimir is permanently united with the Grand Principality of Moscow.
The Kingdom of Kongo is established.
The Triarchy of Negroponte becomes the Kingdom of Negroponte, a colony of the Republic of Venice.
The Duchy of Neopatras is conquered by the Duchy of Athens.
The Joseon Dynasty succeed the Goryeo Dynasty of Korea. Hanseong is the capital.
The Duchy of Milan is established. Milan is the capital.
The Second Bulgarian Empire is disestablished after it is conquered by the Ottoman Empire.
The Tsardom of Vidin is disestablished after it is conquered by the Ottoman Empire.
The Kalmar Union between the Kingdom of Denmark, Kingdom of Norway, and Kingdom of Sweden is established.
The Timurid Empire conquers Delhi.
The Principality of Bayreuth and the Principality of Ansbach are established.
The Principality of Piombino is established. The capital is Piombino.
Hồ Quý Ly establishes the Hồ dynasty in Vietnam. Tây Đô is the capital.
The Timurid Empire conquers Damascus.
The County of Savoy gains the County of Geneva.
The Ming dynasty makes Beijing the second capital after Nanjing.
Owain Glyndŵr is crowned Prince of Wales, holding his Parliament at the capital, Machynlleth.
The Principality of Smolensk becomes part of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
After the death of Timur, the Timurid Empire is split into two parts. The capital is moved from Samarkand to Herat.
The Republic of Pisa is disestablished and annexed into the Republic of Florence.
The Ming dynasty of China conquers the Hồ dynasty of Vietnam, beginning the Fourth Chinese domination of Vietnam.
Giản Định establishes the Later Trần dynasty in Vietnam.
The Gujarat Sultanate is established. Ahmedabad is the capital.
King Zsigmond of Luxemburg moves the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom back to Buda.
Owain Glyndŵr loses Harlech Castle and his ally Edmund Mortimer dies.
The defeat of the State of the Teutonic Order against the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Kingdom of Poland at the Battle of Tannenberg ends its eastern expansion.

links.title: Kingdom of Poland (1385–1569)
links.target: Crown of the Kingdom of Poland

rows.text: The Ottoman Empire annexes the Despotat of Dobruja.
English rule spreads and Machynlleth ceases to assert any claim to be the capital of Wales.
Parakramabahu VI moves the capital of the Sinhala Kingdom to Kotte, in Sri Lanka.
The Ming dynasty of China defeats the Later Trần dynasty of Vietnam.
The autonomous Livonian Order becomes de facto independent from its parent Teutonic Order.
The Adal Sultanate is established.
The Conquest of Ceuta marks the beginning of the Portuguese Empire.
Amadeus VIII establishes the Duchy of Savoy from the County of Savoy. Chambéry remains the capital.
The County of Cleves is raised to the status of a duchy. Cleves is the capital.
The Principality of Wallachia becomes a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire.
The Electorate of Brandenburg moves its capital from Brandenburg an der Havel to Berlin.
Start of the second personal union between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of France.
The Kingdom of Cyprus becomes a vassal state of the Mamluks.
End of the Fourth Chinese domination of Vietnam.
Thái Tổ establishes the Later Lê dynasty in Vietnam. Đông Kinh is the capital.
Abu'l-Khayr Khan establishes the Uzbek Khanate. Chimgi-Tura is the capital.
The Aztec Empire in Mexico is established from the union of three city-states.
The Ryukyu Kingdom is established. Shuri is the capital.
The Songhai Empire becomes independent from the Mali Empire. Gao is the capital.
The Khmer Empire is dissolved after the invasion of the Ayutthaya Kingdom.
The Principality of Achaea is annexed by the Byzantine Empire.
Burgundy acquires the County of Hainaut.
The Republic of Genoa reconquers Corsica from the Kingdom of Aragon.
The Archbishopric of Riga sells its Dondangen Parish to the Bishopric of Courland.
The Archbishopric of Riga, the bishoprics of Courland, Dorpat and Ösel-Wiek, the autonomous Livonian Order of the Teutonic Order, and the town of Riga form the Livonian Confederation.
The Khanate of Kazan splits from the Golden Horde. Kazan is the capital.
The Inca Empire is established. Cusco is the capital.
The Sukhothai Kingdom is annexed by the Ayutthaya Kingdom in Siam.
The Khanate of Crimea splits from the Golden Horde.
The Albanian Principalities are unified to form the Albanian League of Lezhë.
Ambrosian Republic supersedes the Duchy of Milan
Duchy of Milan supersedes Ambrosian Republic

The Archbishopric of Riga and the autonomous Livonian Order of the Teutonic Order agree with a condominium over the nominally free town of Riga, until then under the de facto control of the Livonian Order.
France annexes the Duchy of Aquitaine.
The Duchy of Austria becomes the Archduchy of Austria. Vienna remains the capital.

The Byzantine Empire falls to the Ottoman Empire. The capital of the Ottoman Empire is moved to Constantinople (now Istanbul, Turkey). The political situation leads to the closure of the Silk Road to trade, forcing European merchants to seek sea routes to Asian markets and thereby initiating the "Age of Discovery".
End of the second personal union between the Kingdom of France and the Kingdom of England after the end of the Hundred Years' War.
The State of the Teutonic Order moves its capital from Marienburg to Königsberg.
The Kingdom of Imereti becomes independent from the Kingdom of Georgia. Kutaisi is the capital.
The Duchy of Bouillon is founded. Bouillon is the capital.
The Republic of Ragusa becomes a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire.
The Duchy of Athens is annexed by the Ottoman Empire.
The Teutonic Order cedes its already leased-out former Danish Estonia over to its autonomous Livonian Order.
The Empire of Trebizond is conquered by the Ottoman Empire as the last successor state of the Byzantine Empire.
Moghulistan splits into two parts.
The uninhabited Cape Verde Islands become a colony of Portugal.
The Ottoman Empire annexes the Kingdom of Bosnia.
The County of East Frisia is established.
The Songhai Empire conquers Timbuktu from the Mali Empire.
The Kazakh Khanate is established. Sozak is the capital.
The Kingdom of Kakheti is established. Gremi is the capital.

The Second Peace treaty of Thorn.Poland gains Michałow land, Chełmno land with Toruń, Gdańsk, Pomerania, Warmia and Żuławy with Malbork and Elbląg.Teutonic order becomes a vassal of the Kingdom of Poland

links.title: Kingdom of Poland (1385-1569)
links.target: Crown of the Kingdom of Poland

rows.text: The Khanate of Sibir splits from the Golden Horde.
The tribal empire of Kara Koyunlu is disestablished.
The crowns of the Iberian Christian kingdoms of Castile and Aragon were united by the marriage of Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon, as the Kingdom of Spain.
The Triarchy of Negroponte is annexed by the Ottoman Empire.
The Chimú Empire is conquered by the Inca Empire.
João de Santarém discovers São Tomé and takes possession of it for the Kingdom of Portugal.
The Kingdom of Portugal conquers Tangier.
Ludlow becomes the administrative capital of Wales, as the site of the Council of Wales and the Marches.

links.title: Council of Wales and the Marches

rows.text: The Kingdom of Scotland annexes Orkney and Shetland.
Beginning of the rule of the Wattasid dynasty over Morocco. Fez is the capital.
Mechelen becomes the capital of the Burgundian Netherlands.
The Duchy of Holstein is created from the County of Holstein-Rendsburg.
The Sengoku period begins in Japan. The Ashikaga shogunate ends and Japan falls apart into small principalities.
The Canary Islands are conquered by the Catholic Monarchs of Spain.
The Grand Principality of Moscow annexes the Novgorod Republic.
The Kingdom of Kartli is established. Tbilisi is the capital.
The Albanian League of Lezhë is annexed by the Ottoman Empire.
The Republic of Venice loses parts of the Adriatic coast to the Ottoman Empire.
According to temple records, a cyclone destroys the land bridge (Adam's Bridge) connecting the Kingdom of Kandy (in present-day Sri Lanka) and Mainland India.
After the Great Stand on the Ugra River, the Grand Principality of Moscow ceases to be a vassal state of the Golden Horde.

links.title: Great Stand on the Ugra River

rows.text: France gains the County of Provence.
The Burgundian Netherlands are disestablished and become the Austrian Netherlands as part of the Habsburg monarchy.
France gains the Duchy of Burgundy.
King Matthias I moves the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom to Bécs.
The Astrakhan Khanate splits from the Golden Horde.
Bartolomeu Dias rounds the Cape of Good Hope.
The Kingdom of Cyprus falls to the Republic of Venice.
King Vladislaus II moves the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom back to Buda.
The Kingdom of Georgia is divided into different parts.
The combined forces of Castile and Aragon capture the Emirate of Granada, completing Spain's Reconquista.
Vasco da Gama discovers a sea route to India.
Christopher Columbus arrives at Xamayca.

While seeking a route to the East Indies, Genoese navigator Cristoforo Colombo (Christopher Columbus) lands on the island of Guanahani in the Lucayan Archipelago, which he mistakes for the Japanese archipelago. Columbus claims the archipelago for his patrons the Crowns of Castile and Aragon (Spain), and subsequently explores and claims Cuba and Hispaniola.

Spanish Pope Alexander VI issues the papal bull Inter caetera granting to the Crowns of Castile and Aragon (Spain) all newly discovered lands west of the meridian 100 leagues west of any of the islands of the Azores (approximately 38°11' west of Greenwich.)

Representatives of the Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal sign the Treaty of Tordesillas, settling the countries' boundary of conquest in the Americas (and Africa and Asia) at a meridian 46°0' west of Greenwich.
The Duchy of Württemberg is established out of the County of Württemberg. Stuttgart remains the capital.
Vasco da Gama reaches Mozambique and takes possession of it for Portugal.
Spain creates the Province of Tierra Firme (Spanish Main) in the Americas.
The Safavids conquer Persia. Tabriz is the capital.
The Kingdom of Portugal conquers Mombasa.

Portuguese navigator Pedro Álvares Cabral arrives at the coast of Brazil and claims all land in South America east of the Tordesillas Meridian for the Kingdom of Portugal, thus establishing the Portuguese Colony of Brazil.
João da Nova discovers Ascension Island.
The Wadai Sultanate is established.
The Uzbek Khanate is disestablished.
The Golden Horde is disestablished following the death of Shaykh Ahmad.
The Aceh Sultanate is established. Kutaraja is the capital.
The Kingdom of Naples is ceded to the Crown of Aragon.
The colony of Portuguese India is established. Kochi is the capital.
Fall of the Timurid Empire. The Khanate of Bukhara is created from areas of the former empire. Samarkand is the capital.
The Delhi Sultanate moves its capital from Delhi to Agra.
The Kingdom of Portugal conquers Muscat.
The Portuguese Empire captures the island of Socrota from Mahra Sultanate with a fleet of 14 ships in the Battle of Socrota. The colony Portuguese Socotra is established and Suq is its capital.
The Kingdom of Portugal conquers Goa.
The Grand Duchy of Moscow annexes the Pskov Republic.
The Khanate of Khiva is established in Central Asia. Old Urgench is the capital.
The Kingdom of Portugal conquers Malacca.
Portuguese Socrota is abandoned and the Mahra Sultanate retakes control of the island of Socrota.
Juan Ponce de León claims Florida for Spain.
The Principality of Moldavia becomes a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire.
Algeria becomes a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire as the Regency of Algiers.
The Ottoman Empire conquers Egypt from the Mamluks.
Fall of the Majapahit Empire in Indonesia.
The Sultanate of Maguindanao is established.
Mayadunne establishes the Kingdom of Sitawaka in Sri Lanka from the Sinhala Kingdom at Kotte. Sitawaka is the capital.

A combined Portuguese-Hormuz force led by António Correia conquered Bahrain but briefly lost it to the princes of Al-Hasa the same year. In response, the Portuguese sent another expedition to Bahrain and the Arabian coast to subdue the Al-Hasa and stop their attempts to regain power.

The combined forces of Hernán Cortés conquer Tenochtitlan, capital of the Aztec Empire. The Kingdom of Spain subsequently renames the region Viceroyalty of New Spain. The destroyed capital is rebuilt and renamed México.
Ferdinand Magellan circumnavigates the Earth.
The Kalmar Union is dissolved.
The Teutonic Order relinquishes its rights over its autonomous Livonian Order.
The Duchy of Prussia emerges from the State of the Teutonic Order. Königsberg is the capital.
Babur defeats the sultan of Delhi, establishing the Mughal Empire. Agra is the capital.

Archduke Ferdinand of Austria is elected the next King of Bohemia and Hungary following the death of Louis II of Hungary and Bohemia, ruling the lands which would come to be known as the Habsburg monarchy.

links.title: Louis II of Hungary and Bohemia

rows.text: After the Battle of Mohács, large parts of Hungary and Croatia fall to the Ottoman Empire.

links.title: Croatia in union with Hungary
links.target: Croatia in personal union with Hungary

rows.text: Thái Tổ establishes the Mạc dynasty in Vietnam.
The Kingdom of Croatia is established as part of the Habsburg monarchy. Zagreb is the capital.
The Bahmani Sultanate is dissolved.
The County of Lippe is established from the Lordship of Lippe. Detmold is the capital.

Representatives of the Kingdom of Portugal and the Kingdom of Spain sign the Treaty of Zaragoza, settling each nation's legal boundary of conquest in Asia and Oceania at a meridian 144°40' west of Greenwich.
Spain creates the Governorate of New Castile and New Toledo in South America with the Capitulation of Toledo.
The First Siege of Vienna by the Ottoman Empire fails.
The Duchy of Mantua is established in northern Italy. Mantua is the capital.
The Order of Saint John annexes Malta and moves the capital from Mdina to Birgu.

links.title: History of Malta under the Order of Saint John

rows.text: The Kingdom of France annexes the Duchy of Brittany.

links.title: Early Modern France
links.target: France in the early modern period

rows.text: The Duchy of Florence replaces the Republic of Florence. Florence remains the capital.
The Later Lê dynasty in Vietnam is restored under Trang Tông.
Francisco Pizarro leads an army into Cuzco, completing the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire.

links.title: Spanish conquest of Peru
links.target: Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire

rows.text: The Kingdom of Portugal divides its Colony of Brazil into 15 independent captaincies.
Spain creates via capitulations the Governorate of New Andalusia and New León in South America.
The colony of New France is established in North America.
The Ottoman Empire conquers Baghdad from the Safavids.
King Ferdinand I moves the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom to Pozsony.
Denmark-Norway emerges as a dual monarchy after the withdrawal of the Kingdom of Sweden from the Kalmar Union.
Spain claims the territories to the south of the Strait of Magellan creating the Governorate of Terra Australis.
Sher Shah Suri establishes the Sur Empire, which dominates northern India and follows the Mughal Empire. Sasaram is the capital.
The Kingdom of Ireland supersedes the feudal Lordship of Ireland.
The Kingdom of England annexes the Principality of Wales.
The Viceroyalty of Peru is established as an overseas territory of Spain.
The Trịnh lords establish de facto control over northern Vietnam.
The Duchy of Parma is established from parts of the Duchy of Milan.
Ivan the Terrible proclaims the Tsardom of Russia, which follows the Grand Duchy of Moscow. Moscow is the capital.
County of Stolberg is divided into Stolberg-Stolberg and Stolberg-Rochefort.
The Kingdom of Portugal establishes a central government for its Colony of Brazil, with Salvador as the capital.
The Saadi dynasty is established in Morocco. Taroudant is the capital.
The Kingdom of Loango is established.
The Ottoman Empire conquers Muscat from Portugal.
The Tsardom of Russia annexes the Khanate of Kazan.
Fall of the Wattasid dynasty in Morocco.
The Republic of Siena is conquered by the Kingdom of Spain and most of it is granted to the Duchy of Florence. The Stato dei Presidi remain with Spain.
The Safavids in Persia move their capital from Tabriz to Qazvin.
The Sur Empire is annexed by the restored Mughal Empire.
Portugal establishes a settlement in Macau.
France reconquers Calais from England.
The Nguyễn lords establish de facto control over central and southern Vietnam.
Russia conquers the Bishopric of Dorpat in Estonia.
The Mali Empire moves its capital from Niani to Kangaba.
The Kingdom of Gorkha is founded. Gorkha is the capital.
The Bishopric of Ösel-Wiek in Western Estonia is sold to Denmark.
Lan Xang in Laos moves its capital from Luang Prabang to Vientiane.
The Bishopric of Courland in Western Latvia is sold to Denmark.
The northern Livonian Order regions of Harrien-Wierland (without Reval) and Jerwen pledge allegiance to Sweden.
The northern Livonian Order town Reval pledges allegiance to Sweden.

The Treaty of Vilnius dissolves the Livonian Order, which is in part organized as the Principality of Livonia in personal union with Lithuania, and in part organized as the Lithuanian vassal state Duchy of Courland and Semigallia, taking effect on 5 March 1562. The Archbishopric of Riga also becomes a vassal state of Lithuania and the former condominium town of Riga becomes a free imperial city.
Turin replaces Chambéry as capital of the Duchy of Savoy.
Sweden conquers from Denmark the former areas of the Bishopric of Ösel-Wiek in Wiek and Dagö, leaving Denmark only with its possessions in Ösel.

The Bailiff of Soneburg of the former Livonian Order, now the Principality of Livonia, sells its bailiwick in the West Estonian archipelago to the Danish-controlled former Bishopric of Ösel-Wiek. In return, Denmark cedes its nominal rights over Swedish-controlled Wiek to the Lithuanian Principality of Livonia.
The Kingdom of Spain establishes a colony in the Philippines with its administrative centre in Cebu.

The Union of Grodno turns the personal union between the Principality of Livonia and Grand Duchy of Lithuania into a real union and the former is reorganized as the Duchy of Livonia. The Lithuanian vassal state Archbishopric of Riga is annexed to the Duchy of Livonia.
The Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania unite to form the Commonwealth of the Crown of the Polish Kingdom and Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Vilnius yields to Kraków as the capital.

links.title: Kingdom of Poland (1385-1569)
links.target: Crown of the Kingdom of Poland

links.title: Commonwealth of the Crown of the Polish Kingdom and Grand Duchy of Lithuania

rows.text: The Grand Duchy of Tuscany is established from the Duchy of Florence. Florence remains the capital.
The Kingdom of Livonia is established as a vassal state of Russia in some of its conquered lands in Livonia.
Denmark cedes its nominal rights over Dagö and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth cedes its nominal rights over Harrien-Wierland (including Reval), Jerwen and Wiek to Sweden.
The Mughal Empire moves its capital from Agra to Fatehpur Sikri.
The Kingdom of Spain conquers the Luzon Empire.
The Order of Saint John moves the capital of Malta from Birgu to Valletta.

links.title: History of Malta under the Order of Saint John

rows.text: The Danish-controlled former Bishopric of Ösel-Wiek is annexed as Danish Ösel.
The Kingdom of Portugal divides the Colony of Brazil into North Brazil (capital at Salvador) and South Brazil (capital at Rio de Janeiro).

links.title: Governorate General of Rio de Janeiro

rows.text: |The Gujarat Sultanate is annexed by the Mughal Empire.
In Japan, the Azuchi-Momoyama period follows the Sengoku period.
The Ottoman Empire conquers the island of Cyprus from the Republic of Venice.
The Kingdom of Portugal establishes colonies on the coast of Angola.
The capital of Chile is moved from Concepción to Santiago.
The Bengal Sultanate is annexed by the Mughal Empire.
The Russian vassal state Kingdom of Livonia is disestablished.
The Adal Sultanate is disestablished.
The Kingdom of Portugal reunites North Brazil and South Brazil into the Colony of Brazil. The capital is Salvador.

links.title: Governorate General of Rio de Janeiro

rows.text: The Danish-controlled Bishopric of Courland becomes a vassal state of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
The Duchy of the Archipelago is annexed by the Ottoman Empire.
Yermak Timofeyevich invades the territory of the Voguls, beginning the Russian conquest of Siberia.
A personal union of the Monarchy of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal results in the Iberian Union.
The Treaty of Drohiczyn cedes the free imperial city of Riga to the Polish-Lithuanian Duchy of Livonia.
The Republic of the Seven United Netherlands declares its independence from the Monarchy of Spain.

links.title: Republic of the Seven United Netherlands

rows.text: The Truce of Yam-Zapolsky cedes the Russian-controlled areas in former central and southern Livonia to the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
The Treaty of Plussa cedes all the remaining Russian-controlled areas in former Livonia to Sweden.
Areas under Swedish control in Northern Estonia are annexed as the Duchy of Estonia.
The Treaty of Kronborg formally cedes the nominally Danish but Polish-Lithuanian-controlled former Bishopric of Courland to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
The Kingdom of Luba is established in central Africa.
The Mughal Empire moves its capital from Fatehpur Sikri to Lahore. In the same year the capital is moved again to Agra.
Portugal establishes the colony of Portuguese Timor.
Through its victory in the Ottoman-Safavid War, the Ottoman Empire expands eastwards.
Fall of the Songhai Empire in West Africa.
Japan invades the Korean Peninsula under Toyotomi Hideyoshi with the aim of attacking the Ming dynasty of China.
Vimaladharmasuriya I moves the capital of the Sinhala Kingdom to Kandy, Sri Lanka.
Willem Barentsz makes the first indisputable discovery of the Svalbard archipelago.
The Duchy of Ferrara becomes part of the Papal States.
Kuchum, Khan of Sibir, is killed in battle with Russian forces, thus completing the Russian conquest of Siberia.
Japan withdraws from the Korean Peninsula after being pushed back by Chinese and Korean troops.
The Safavids move their capital from Qazvin to Isfahan.
The Kingdom of Dahomey is established.
The British East India Company is established.
France gains Bresse, Bugey, and Gex from Savoy, and cedes Saluzzo to Savoy in exchange.
The Dutch East India Company is established.
Tokugawa Ieyasu establishes the Tokugawa shogunate in Japan, which follows the Azuchi-Momoyama period. Edo is the capital.
The Virginia Colony is founded in North America.
The Kingdom of Portugal divides the Colony of Brazil into North Brazil (capital at Salvador) and South Brazil (capital at Rio de Janeiro) for the second time.

links.title: Governorate General of Rio de Janeiro

rows.text: The Protestant Union is founded in the Holy Roman Empire.
Quebec City is founded as the capital of New France.
The Ryukyu Kingdom becomes a vassal state of the Tokugawa shogunate.
The Catholic League is founded in the Holy Roman Empire.
Henry Hudson discovers Hudson Bay.
England establishes the Newfoundland Colony in North America.
The Kingdom of Portugal reunites North Brazil and South Brazil into the Colony of Brazil. The capital is Salvador.

links.title: Governorate General of Rio de Janeiro

rows.text: The Kingdom of Portugal establishes the colony of Cacheu in what is now Guinea-Bissau.
Taizu establishes the Later Jin dynasty in China.
In the Treaty of Stolbovo, Sweden gains the Russian province and fortress of Kexholm (now Priozersk) and the province of Ingria including the fortress of Nöteborg (now Shlisselburg, Russia).
The Polish-Lithuanian vassal state Bishopric of Courland comes into personal union with Poland-Lithuania.
The Second Defenestration of Prague marks the beginning of the Thirty Years' War between the Catholic League and the Protestant Union in the Holy Roman Empire, which soon grips the whole of Europe.
The personal union of the Electorate of Brandenburg with the Duchy of Prussia creates Brandenburg-Prussia. Berlin and Königsberg are the respective capitals.
The Kasanje Kingdom is founded in central Africa.
The Danish East India Company establishes the colony of Danish India.
Plymouth Colony is founded by the Pilgrim Fathers.
The Kingdom of Portugal divides the Colony of Brazil into the State of Brazil and the State of Maranhão. The capitals are Salvador and São Luis, respectively.
The Dutch West India Company is founded.
Nova Scotia is founded as a colony of the Kingdom of Scotland.
The Electorate of Bavaria emerged from the Duchy of Bavaria. Munich remains the capital.
The colony of New Netherland is established in North America.
The colony of Dutch Formosa is established on Taiwan.
The Dutch purchase the island of Manhattan and found New Amsterdam, which later becomes New York City.
The Kingdom of England colonizes Barbados, with its capital at Saint James Town.
The Massachusetts Bay Colony is founded in North America.
The New Hampshire Colony is founded in North America.
The Carolina Colony is founded in North America.

The Truce of Altmark cedes most of the Duchy of Livonia in real union with the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth to Sweden as Swedish Livonia. The eastern part of the duchy is retained by Poland-Lithuania and is annexed as the Inflanty Voivodeship.
The Dutch establish the colony of Dutch Brazil. The capital is Mauritsstad (now Recife).
Sweden occupies the Duchy of Pomerania.
The Kingdom of Matamba is established in southwest Africa.
The Maryland Colony is founded. St. Mary's City is the capital.
The Kingdom of England colonizes Antigua.
Fasilides makes Gondar the first permanent capital of Ethiopia since the fall of the Zagwe Dynasty.
The Saybrook Colony is founded in what is now the U.S. state of Connecticut. Old Saybrook is the capital.
The Kingdom of France colonizes Guadeloupe, Martinique, and some islands of the Lesser Antilles.
The Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations is founded in North America.

links.title: Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations

rows.text: Taizong establishes the Qing dynasty in China.
The Connecticut Colony is founded in North America. Hartford is the capital.
Joseon becomes a tributary state of the Qing dynasty after the invasion of Korea.
The colony of New Sweden is established in North America.
The New Haven Colony is founded in what is now the U.S. state of Connecticut. New Haven is the capital.
The Dutch East India Company takes possession of Mauritius.
The Emirate of Trarza is established in North Africa.
The Kingdom of Portugal separates from personal union with the Monarchy of Spain.
The Kingdom of Portugal loses Malacca, Annobón, and Angola to the Republic of the Seven United Provinces.

links.title: Republic of the Seven United Provinces

rows.text: Hongguang establishes the Southern Ming dynasty in China.
The Saybrook Colony is sold to the Connecticut Colony.
The Qing dynasty supersedes the Ming dynasty as the legitimate dynasty of China. Beijing is the capital.

The Kingdom of Denmark and Norway, the Wends and the Goths cedes Jämtland, Härjedalen, Idre & Särna, Gotland, Ösel, and Halland, the latter for a period of 30 years, to the Kingdom of Sweden as part of the Treaty of Brömsebro.
The Vijayanagara Empire is dissolved.
The Kingdom of England colonizes the Bahamas.
The Thirty Years' War ends with the Peace of Westphalia.
The Netherlands, Switzerland, and many Italian city-states are made independent of the Holy Roman Empire (Peace of Westphalia).

|The Duchy of Pomerania is divided between Sweden (Swedish Pomerania) and Brandenburg-Prussia (Farther Pomerania), although the precise borders would not be determined until 1653 (Peace of Westphalia).
France receives the cities of the Décapole in Alsace (except Strasbourg, the Diocese of Strasbourg, and Mulhouse) and the city of Pignerol from the Spanish Duchy of Milan (Peace of Westphalia).
The Mughal Empire moves its capital from Agra to Delhi.
The Kingdom of Portugal takes back Angola from the Republic of the Seven United Provinces.

links.title: Republic of the Seven United Provinces

rows.text: Grenada is acquired by the Kingdom of France.
The republican Commonwealth of England supersedes the Kingdom of England after the English Civil War.
The Commonwealth of England colonizes Anguilla with settlers from Saint Kitts.
The Dutch East India Company establishes the Dutch Cape Colony.
The precise borders between Swedish Pomerania and Farther Pomerania (Brandenburg-Prussia) are determined by the Treaty of Stettin.
During the Dutch-Portuguese War, the Kingdom of Portugal conquers the colony of Dutch Brazil from the Republic of the Seven United Provinces.

links.title: Republic of the Seven United Provinces

rows.text: The colony of New Sweden falls to the Dutch.

links.title: Republic of the Seven United Provinces

rows.text: The former Bishopric of Courland, until then in personal union with the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, is sold to the Polish-Lithuanian vassal state Duchy of Courland and Semigallia and becomes its vassal state instead.
The Treaty of Bromberg gives the Duchy of Prussia its sovereignty.
During the Dutch-Portuguese War, the Dutch gain control of Portuguese-held possessions in Sri Lanka from the Kingdom of Portugal.
Denmark-Norway cedes Skåne, Blekinge, Halland, Bornholm, Båhus, and Trøndelag to the Kingdom of Sweden as part of the Treaty of Roskilde.
The Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland supersedes the Commonwealth of England, the Kingdom of Scotland, and the Kingdom of Ireland. Edinburgh and Dublin yield to London as the capital.

links.title: Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland

rows.text: The Kingdom of France establishes the colony of Saint-Louis as the first French settlement in Africa.
Treaty of the Pyrenees: Artois, Roussillon, and Perpignan are annexed by Kingdom of France.
Fall of the Saadi dynasty in Morocco.
|The British East India Company takes possession of Saint Helena.

The restored Kingdom of England, Kingdom of Scotland, and Kingdom of Ireland supersede the republican Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland. London, Edinburgh, and Dublin are the respective capitals.

links.title: Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland

rows.text: The Treaty of Oliva cedes Runö Island in Estonia from the Polish-Lithuanian vassal state Duchy of Courland and Semigallia to Sweden.
The Kingdom of Sweden cedes Trøndelag and Bornholm to Denmark-Norway as part of the Treaty of Copenhagen.
Portuguese India cedes the port of Bombay to the British as dowry to King Charles II of England
The Kingdom of Portugal hands Tangier over to the Kingdom of England as a dowry.

The former Bishopric of Courland, a vassal state of the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia (itself a vassal state of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth), comes into personal union with Courland and Semigallia.
The Kingdom of Tungning is proclaimed in Taiwan.
The Southern Ming dynasty ends with the conquest by the Qing dynasty.
Dutch Formosa is conquered by the Southern Ming dynasty.
The Duchy of Massa and Carrara is established. Massa is the capital.
The Dutch Republic signs the Treaty of Breda, which cedes New Netherland to the Kingdom of England.
The Delaware Colony is founded in North America. New Castle is the capital.
The New Jersey Colony is founded in North America.
The New York Colony is founded in North America. New York City is the capital.
The New Haven Colony is merged into the Connecticut Colony.
The French East India Company is founded.
The Alawi dynasty is established in Morocco.
The Kingdom of Lunda is established in central Africa.
The Kingdom of England establishes the Colony of Jamaica. Spanish Town is the capital.
The Khanate of Kalat is established.
The Kingdom of France conquers Anguilla from the Kingdom of England.

The Truce of Andrusovo. Left-Bank Ukraine, Kyiv, and Smolensk is given to the Russian Tsardom. Poland-Lithuania was left with Right-Bank Ukraine, and Russian-occupied Belarus with Vitebsk, Polotsk, and Dzwinsk. Zaporizhzhia was recognized as a condominium of both states.
The Kingdom of France returns Anguilla to the Kingdom of England according to the Treaty of Breda.
Kingdom of France acquires Armentières, Bergues, Charleroi, Kortrijk, Douai, Veurne, Lille, Oudenaarde and Tournai (Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle).
The Kingdom of France acquires Puducherry.
Shivaji establishes the Maratha Empire in Maharashtra.
Ottoman Empire gains parts of Podolia and parts of Central Ukraine from Poland-Lithuania
The Mạc dynasty of Vietnam collapses.
The Treaty of Nijmegen is signed. Spain gives Franche-Comté, Ypres, Maubeuge, Câteau-Cambrésis, Valenciennes, Saint-Omer and Cassel to France and France restores Charleroi and Philippsburg
The Kingdom of Burundi is established.
The Pennsylvania Colony is founded in North America. Philadelphia is the capital.
French explorer Robert de La Salle sails down the Mississippi River and claims all the lands along the river for France under the name Louisiana.

links.title: Robert de La Salle
links.target: René-Robert Cavelier, Sieur de La Salle

rows.text: The Tungning Kingdom is conquered by the Qing dynasty. The island of Taiwan falls back under the control of the Qing.
The Second Siege of Vienna by the Ottoman Empire fails.
The English Crown Colony of Bermuda supersedes the Somers Isles Company. Hamilton is the capital.
The Kingdom of England hands Tangier over to the Alawi dynasty.
The Kingdom of England colonizes Barbuda.
Russian Tsardom gains Kiev and Zaporizhzhia from Poland-Lithuania from Treaty of Eternal Peace
Wales ceases to have an official or administrative capital when Ludlow ceases to be the administrative capital following the end of the Council of Wales and the Marches.

links.title: Council of Wales and the Marches

rows.text: Treaty of Nerchinsk is signed between Tsardom of Russia and Qing Dynasty. Russia gives up the area north of the Amur River as far as the Stanovoy Range and kept the area between the Argun River and Lake Baikal.
The Massachusetts Bay Colony and Plymouth Colony are reorganized as the Province of Massachusetts Bay.
The Electorate of Hanover is established. Hanover is the capital.
The capital of Maryland Colony is moved from St. Mary's City to Annapolis.
The western half of the colony of Santo Domingo (Kingdom of Spain) on the island of Hispaniola is recognised as the colony of Saint-Domingue of the Kingdom of France (Peace of Ryswijk).
The Kingdom of France hands over territories to the Holy Roman Empire (Peace of Ryswijk).
The Kingdom of France recognizes the Kingdom of England (Peace of Ryswijk).
A personal union is established between the Electorate of Saxony and Poland-Lithuania.

The Ottoman Empire cedes the Eğri Eyalet, the Varat Eyalet, northern parts of the Temeşvar Eyalet, most of the Budin Eyalet, and parts of the Bosnia Eyalet to the Habsburg monarchy. This territory plus the Principality of Transylvania corresponds to most of the territory of mediaeval Hungary previously lost to the Ottomans (Ottoman Hungary). (Treaty of Karlowitz)
The Principality of Transylvania, while nominally independent, becomes de facto under Habsburg rule. (Treaty of Karlowitz)
The Ottoman Empire returns Podolia to Poland-Lithuania. (Treaty of Karlowitz)
The Ottoman Empire cedes Morea and most of Dalmatia to the Republic of Venice. (Treaty of Karlowitz)
The Ottoman Empire cedes Azov to the Tsardom of Russia by the Treaty of Constantinople.
With the beginning of Philip V's reign over the Kingdom of Spain, Spain and its territories cease to be part of the Habsburg monarchy.
The Duchy of Mecklenburg is divided into Mecklenburg-Schwerin and Mecklenburg-Strelitz.
The Ashanti Empire is established in West Africa. Kumasi is the capital.
Brandenburg-Prussia becomes the Kingdom of Prussia. Berlin is the capital.
The Mamluk dynasty in Iraq is established. Baghdad is the capital.
The Kingdom of France and Spanish Empire take control of Nassau from the English, but soon abandon the city, returning control to the English.
The Electorate of Hanover receives the Principality of Lüneburg and the Duchy of Saxe-Lauenburg.
End of the personal union between the Electorate of Saxony and Poland-Lithuania.
Lan Xang in Laos disintegrates into three parts: the Kingdom of Luang Phrabang in the north, the Kingdom of Vientiane in the middle, and the Kingdom of Champasak in the south.
The Crown of Castile integrates the Kingdom of Valencia part of the Crown of Aragon through invasion (Battle of Almansa).
The Acts of Union 1707 unite the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland to form the Kingdom of Great Britain. Edinburgh yields to London as the capital for all but judicial functions.
The Nueva Planta decrees abolish the Crown of Castile and make it part of the centralized Kingdom of Spain.
Second personal union between the Electorate of Saxony and Poland-Lithuania.
The Khanate of Kokand is established in Central Asia as a spin-off of the Khanate of Bukhara. Kokand is the capital.
Mirwais Hotak establishes the Hotak dynasty. Isfahan and Kandahar are the capitals.
The Kong Empire is established in West Africa.
The Principality of Transylvania is integrated de jure into the Habsburg monarchy as a crown land.
Cap-François becomes the capital of the French colony of Saint-Domingue.
The Duchy of Mirandola becomes part of the Duchy of Modena and Reggio.
The Tsardom of Russia returns Azov to the Ottoman Empire by the Treaty of the Pruth.
The Carolina Colony is split into the North Carolina Colony and the South Carolina Colony.
The Tsardom of Russia moves its capital from Moscow to Saint Petersburg.

The Treaty of Utrecht is signed. The Kingdom of Great Britain takes sovereignty over Gibraltar and Menorca from the Kingdom of Spain. Spain also cedes Sicily and parts of the Duchy of Milan to Savoy; the Spanish Netherlands, the Kingdom of Naples, Sardinia, and the bulk of the Duchy of Milan to Charles VI, Holy Roman Emperor; and lands in South America between the Amazon River and the Oiapoque River to the Kingdom of Portugal.
The Kingdom of France conquers Kaiserslautern, Landau, and Breisgau.
The Electorate of Hanover enters into a personal union with the Kingdom of Great Britain.
The Austrian Netherlands follow the Spanish Netherlands. Brussels is the capital.
The Duchy of Milan, the Kingdom of Sardinia, the Kingdom of Naples, and the Spanish Netherlands are ceded by the Kingdom of Spain to the Habsburg monarchy.
The Habsburg monarchy receives Freiburg im Breisgau and several other small territories on its eastern borders from France, but France keeps Landau.

Fall of the Crown of Aragon, invaded by the Crown of Castile, marked by the Siege of Barcelona and the annexation of the Principality of Catalonia. A unified Kingdom of Spain is created through the Nueva Planta decrees.
The Kingdom of Spain returns Colonia del Sacramento to the Kingdom of Portugal.
The Kingdom of France annexes Mauritius after the Dutch abandon it.
The Nueva Planta decrees abolish the Crown of Castile and make it part of the centralized Kingdom of Spain.
Spain integrates the Kingdom of Majorca, the last part of the Crown of Aragon, through invasion.

The former Bishopric of Courland, until then in personal union with the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia (itself a vassal state of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth), comes into personal union directly with Poland-Lithuania.
The Viceroyalty of New Granada is established from parts of the Viceroyalty of Peru as an overseas territory of the Kingdom of Spain.

The Ottoman Empire cedes to the Habsburg monarchy the territories of Banat, southeastern Syrmia, central Serbia, part of northern Bosnia, and part of Wallachia (an Ottoman vassal) known as Oltenia (Treaty of Passarowitz).
The Kingdom of Serbia is established as a Habsburg crown land (Treaty of Passarowitz).
The Banat of Temeswar is established as a Habsburg crown land (Treaty of Passarowitz).
Venice returns Morea (gained by the Treaty of Karlowitz) and its Cretan holdings to the Ottomans.
The Ottoman Empire cede parts of Dalmatia (Imotski, Sinj, and Vrgorac).
Sweden cedes Bremen-Verden to the Electorate of Hanover.
The Duchy of Savoy receives the Kingdom of Sardinia from the Habsburg monarchy in exchange for Sicily.
The Electorate of the Palatinate moves its capital from Düsseldorf to Mannheim.
Sweden cedes the portion of Swedish Pomerania south of the Peene and east of the Peenestrom to Prussia.
Swedish Estonia, Ingria, Livonia, and most of Karelia is ceded by Sweden to the Tsardom of Russia according to the terms of the Treaty of Nystad.
Peter the Great proclaims the Russian Empire from the Tsardom of Russia.
The Viceroyalty of New Granada again becomes part of the Viceroyalty of Peru.
On Greenland (then part of Denmark-Norway), Hans Egede founds the colony of Godthåb.
The Georgia Colony is founded in British North America. Savannah is the capital.
The Afsharid dynasty is established in Persia and follows the Safavid dynasty. Mashhad is the capital.
The Kingdom of Portugal moves the capital of its colonial State of Maranhão from São Luís to Belém.
The Hotak dynasty is disestablished.

Habsburg Monarchy loses the crowns of Naples and Sicily to Charles of Parma, the Duchy of Lorraine to Stanislaus Leszczyński, the Duchy of Parma to Austria, the Grand Duchy of Tuscany to Francis Stephen, the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth loses direct control over the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia.
The Viceroyalty of New Granada is again separated from the Viceroyalty of Peru.
Jean-Baptiste Charles Bouvet de Lozier discovers Bouvet Island in the South Atlantic Ocean.
The Habsburg monarchy cedes the Kingdom of Serbia, the southern part of the Banat of Temeswar, and northern Bosnia to the Ottoman Empire (Treaty of Belgrade).
The Habsburg monarchy returns Oltenia to Wallachia (Treaty of Belgrade).
The Oyo Empire is established in West Africa.
Treaty of Berlin:Silesia is Partitioned between Prussia and the House of Habsburg;Prussia receives the majority of silesia while Austria retains a smaller area hence known as Austrian Silesia
The Kingdom of Matamba is annexed to Portuguese Angola.
The kingdoms of Croatia and Slavonia are unified into the Kingdom of Croatia-Slavonia within the Habsburg monarchy. Zagreb is the capital.
The Kingdom of Swaziland is established in southern Africa.
The Safavid Empire collapses.
The Durrani Empire is founded near Kandahar on a Loya jirga, when Ahmad Shah Abdali is chosen as the king of the newly independent empire. He is later regarded as the founder of modern Afghanistan.
Duchies of Parma, Piacenza, and Gustalla ceded to the Spanish Bourbons (Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle).

The Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal sign the Treaty of Madrid. Based on the uti possidetis concept, Portugal gains lands on the actual south, central, and north regions of Brazil. The treaty also stipulates that Spain receive the Colonia del Sacramento and Portugal the Misiones Orientales.
The Kingdom of Portugal changes the name of its colonial State of Maranhão to State of Great-Pará and Maranhão.
Karim Khan establishes the Zand dynasty in Persia. Shiraz is the capital.

Through the Treaty of Strömstad, the border between Sweden and Norway is finally settled, from the beginning of the land border in Iddefjord until Norway's border on Russia at Varanger (since Finland was part of Sweden at this time, the border between the two countries continued beyond the present end point of the border between Norway and Sweden).
Establishment of the Konbaung dynasty in Burma. Shwebo is the capital.
The Sheikdom of Kuwait is established. Kuwait City is the capital.
During the Seven Years' War, France occupies the island of Menorca.
The British East India Company gains control of Bengal from the Mughal Empire, initiating the British Raj in India.
The Dzungar Khanate is annexed by the Qing dynasty of China.
The Kingdom of Great Britain conquers Senegambia from the Kingdom of France.
The Sultanate of Sulu becomes independent from the Bruneian Empire.
The Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal sign the Treaty of El Pardo, nullifying the Treaty of Madrid.
The Kingdom of Kartli and the Kingdom of Kakheti unite to form the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti. Tbilisi is the capital.
Following the end of the French and Indian War in North America, the Louisiana Territory is transferred from France to Spain in the secret Treaty of Fontainebleau.
End of the second personal union between the Electorate of Saxony and Poland-Lithuania.

The Seven Years' War ends with the Treaty of Paris, which formalizes a number of territorial transfers between Great Britain, France, and Spain; among these is the transfer of the northernmost parts of New France (present-day Canada) to the British.
The Kingdom of Portugal moves the capital of its colony of the State of Brazil from Salvador to Rio de Janeiro.
The Grand Duchy of Transylvania follows the Principality of Transylvania.
France annexes the Duchy of Lorraine.
Ayutthaya, capital of the Ayutthaya Kingdom, is destroyed during the Burmese–Siamese War. The Thonburi Kingdom follows the Ayutthaya Kingdom in Siam.
Genoa sells to France its rights to Corsica.
Prithvi Narayan Shah unifies the Kingdom of Nepal. Kathmandu is the capital.
The capital of the French colony of Saint-Domingue is moved from Cap-François to Port-au-Prince.
James Cook reaches Australia and takes possession of the land for the Kingdom of Great Britain.
The Kingdom of Portugal divides its colony of the State of Great-Pará and Maranhão into the State of Great-Pará (capital at Belém) and the State of Maranhão (capital at São Luis).
Following Ayutthaya's destruction in 1767, the new capital of Siam is created in Thonburi.
The Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria is founded as the crown land of the Habsburg monarchy. Lemberg is the capital.
First partition of Poland.
The County of Oldenburg is made the Duchy of Oldenburg.
The Kingdom of Portugal reunites its South American colonies of the State of Brazil, the State of Great-Pará, and the State of Maranhão into the Colony of Brazil. Rio de Janeiro is the capital.
The Habsburg monarchy annexes the northwestern part of Moldavia (later known as Bukovina).
The Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata is separated from the Viceroyalty of Peru. The Kingdom of Chile losses the cities of Mendoza and San Juan (Cuyo Province). Buenos Aires is the capital.

links.title: Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The Durrani Empire moves its capital from Kandahar to Kabul. The winter capital is Peshawar.
The American colonies occupy Nassau from the British during the American Revolutionary War.
The American colonies abandon Nassau, returning control to the British during the American Revolutionary War.
The Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations declares its independence from the Kingdom of Great Britain. Providence is the capital.

links.title: Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations

rows.text: Thirteen British colonies in North America, including the State of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations, collectively declare their independence from the Kingdom of Great Britain, as the United States of America. Philadelphia is the first of eight cities that will serve as a temporary capital until 1800.
The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Philadelphia to Baltimore.
The Republic of New Connecticut declares its independence from the Kingdom of Great Britain. Westminster is the temporary capital.
The United States of America moves its temporary capital back from Baltimore to Philadelphia.
The Republic of New Connecticut moves its capital from Westminster to Windsor.
The Republic of New Connecticut changes its name to the Vermont Republic.
The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Philadelphia to Lancaster for one day, following the capture of Philadelphia by British forces.
The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Lancaster to York.

The Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal sign the First Treaty of San Ildefonso, confirming almost all the borders defined by the Treaty of Madrid, with the exception that Spain will rule both Colonia del Sacramento and the Misiones Orientales.
|Thái Đức establishes the Tây Sơn dynasty in Vietnam.
The Kingdom of Portugal cedes Annobón and Bioko to the Kingdom of Spain.
The Kingdom of Champasak becomes a vassal state of Siam.
The Vermont Republic claims the "East Union", consisting of some towns in New Hampshire which had petitioned earlier in the year to join with Vermont. Vermont never gains full control over the area.
The United States of America moves its temporary capital from York back to Philadelphia.
The Vermont Republic rescinds its claim to the "East Union", consisting of some towns in New Hampshire.

The Vermont Republic once again claims the "East Union", consisting of some towns in New Hampshire that wish to join with Vermont, though the exact extent of the borders is unknown. Vermont never gains full control over the area.
The Vermont Republic claims the "West Union", consisting of some towns in New York. The specific date this occurs is unclear; sources suggest 16 June, 26 June, and 18 July.
The Vermont Republic abandons its claims of the East Union from New Hampshire and the West Union from New York.
Siam moves its capital from Thonburi to Bangkok.
The Spanish Empire captures The Bahamas from the Kingdom of Great Britain.
The Province of Trinidad moves its capital from San José de Oruña to Puerto de España.
Great Britain surrenders East Florida and West Florida to Spain.
The Kingdom of Great Britain recaptures The Bahamas from the Spanish Empire.
The Crimean Khanate is annexed by the Russian Empire and incorporated as the Taurida Governorate.
The Kingdom of Great Britain signs the Treaty of Paris, formally recognizing the independence of the United States of America.

Rule over Senegambia is redistributed between the Kingdom of Great Britain and the Kingdom of France. The French get most of Senegambia (present-day Senegal) and the British get the Gambia Valley (present-day Gambia).
The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Philadelphia to Princeton, and then to Annapolis.
King Joseph II moves the capital of the Hungarian Kingdom back to Buda.
Russian seafarer and merchant Grigory Ivanovich Shelikhov arrives in Three Saints Bay in Alaska.
The Khanate of Kalat hands over Gwadar to Oman.
King Gustav III of Sweden acquires the island of Saint Barthélemy in the Caribbean from France. It becomes a Swedish colony for nearly a century.
The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Annapolis to Trenton.
The Emirate of Bukhara follows the Khanate of Bukhara.
The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Trenton to New York City.
Andrianampoinimerina establishes the Kingdom of Madagascar. Antananarivo is the capital.
The British colony of New South Wales is established in Australia.
The Later Lê dynasty of Vietnam collapses.
The Principality of Lippe is formed from the County of Lippe.
The United States of Belgium declares its independence from the House of Habsburg. Brussels is the capital.
The United States of America moves its temporary capital from New York City to Philadelphia pending the construction of the new capital permitted by the new United States Constitution.
The United States of Belgium capitulates to the House of Habsburg.
The Vermont Republic joins the United States of America as the State of Vermont. Windsor yields to Philadelphia as the federal capital.
The Dutch West India Company is dissolved.
The Principality of Ansbach and the Principality of Bayreuth become part of the Kingdom of Prussia.
The first French Republic supersedes the Kingdom of France.
Most of the Prince-Bishopric of Basel becomes the Rauracian Republic, retaining only Schliengen.
Second partition of Poland.
France annexes the Principality of Salm-Salm.
The Rauracian Republic is annexed by France to form the département of Mont-Terrible.
Avignon is transferred from the Papal States to the French First Republic.
Aga Mohammed Khan establishes the Qajar dynasty in Persia after the collapse of the Zand dynasty. Tehran is the capital.
The Republic of Senarica is annexed by the Kingdom of Naples.
The Trans-Oconee Republic is established by Elijah Clarke, in an attempt to head off the new Federal government's ceding of lands claimed by Georgia back to the Creek.

links.title: Federal government of the United States

rows.text: 1,200 Georgia militiamen as well as U.S. federal troops surround and isolate fortifications in the Trans-Oconee Republic and the nation's founder Elijah Clarke and his followers surrender and leave the settlements, destroying the republic as a result.
France annexes Southern Netherlands and the Duchy of Bouillon.
The Dutch lose its territories held in Malacca and Sri Lanka to the British.
The Batavian Republic supersedes the Republic of the Seven United Netherlands. Amsterdam is the capital.

links.title: Republic of the Seven United Netherlands

rows.text: A revolt occurs in Swellendam in the Dutch Cape Colony due to dissatisfaction with the Dutch East India Company and the Republic of Swellendam is declared.

The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth is partitioned. Its vassal state Duchy of Courland and Semigallia and the former Bishopric of Courland, until then in personal union with Poland-Lithuania, are annexed to the Russian Empire together as its Courland Governorate.
British occupation in the Cape brings an end to the Republic of Swellendam.
Spain cedes the northern half of West Florida to the United States of America.
The Napoleonic Cispadane Republic is created in northern Italy from the Duchy of Modena and Reggio, the Duchy of Massa and Carrara and the Papal States. Modena is the capital.
The Cispadane Republic becomes the Cisalpine Republic. Milan is the capital.
The Habsburg monarchy annexes the Republic of Venice.
The Republic of Genoa becomes the Napoleonic Ligurian Republic. Genoa is the capital.
The Austrian Netherlands and various Mediterranean islands, including Corfu, are ceded to France. (Treaty of Campo Formio)

The Republic of Venice is dissolved. Venetia (the eastern portion of Domini di Terraferma, roughly modern Veneto and Friuli-Venezia Giulia), Istria, and Dalmatia are annexed by Austria. (Treaty of Campo Formio)
Austria recognizes the Cisalpine Republic and Ligurian Republic. (Treaty of Campo Formio)
The Kingdom of Italy is recognized as defunct and all subordinate territories are formally released from the Holy Roman Empire. (Treaty of Campo Formio)
France annexes Mulhouse.
The Kingdom of Chile is separated from the Viceroyalty of Peru. Santiago is the capital.
The Napoleonic Helvetic Republic is declared. Aarau is the capital.
The Order of Saint John capitulates to French forces and Malta is under French occupation with Valletta remaining the capital.
France conquers Egypt from the Ottoman Empire.
The Gozitan Nation gains de facto independence from Malta with Rabat as its capital.
The Principality of Lippe follows the County of Lippe.
The Dutch East India Company is dissolved.
Establishment of the Sikh Empire after capture of Lahore by Maharaja Ranjit Singh and unification of the Sikh Confederacy under him.

The State of Muskogee is proclaimed by William Augustus Bowles, a Loyalist veteran of the American Revolutionary War who lived among the Muscogee, in what is now the U.S. state of Florida. Its capital was Mikasuke.
The Dutch East Indies are established by the Batavian Republic after the dissolution of the Dutch East India Company. Batavia is the capital.
The French département of Mont-Terrible is merged into the département of Haut-Rhin.
French forces in Malta surrender to the British. The island becomes the British protectorate of Malta with Valletta as capital.
After a secretly negotiated treaty between France and Spain, Spain returns the North American colony of Louisiana to France.
The United States of America moves its capital from Philadelphia to its permanent location at Washington in the District of Columbia.
Egypt again falls under the control of the Ottoman Empire.
The Kingdom of Great Britain and the Kingdom of Ireland unite to form the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. Dublin yields to London as the capital.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal sign the Treaty of Badajoz, by which Spain cedes the South American Misiones Orientales to Portugal, and Portugal cedes Olivenza to Spain.
The Gozitan Nation is annexed by the British protectorate of Malta.
The Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti is annexed by the Russian Empire.
Napoleon separates the Canton of Valais from the Helvetic Republic to form the Rhodanic Republic.
Gia Long establishes the Nguyễn dynasty in Vietnam. Huế is the capital.
Trinidad becomes a British colony.
The Cisalpine Republic is renamed the Italian Republic.
The United Kingdom establishes the Crown Colony of British Ceylon in Sri Lanka.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Ottoman Empire reconquers Iraq from the Mamluk dynasty.
The State of Muskogee is destroyed after its Director General, William Augustus Bowles, is captured by the Spanish.
The Act of Mediation converts the Helvetic Republic into the Swiss Confederation.

The Reichsdeputationshauptschluss results in the following geopolitical changes: * All but three ecclesiastical states of the Holy Roman Empire are either secularized or annexed by other states (the exceptions are the Archbishopric of Regensburg and the lands of the Teutonic Knights and Knights of Saint John). * The Duchy of Salzburg (formerly the Archbishopric of Salzburg) is raised to an electorate. * The Electorate of Baden emerges from the Margraviate of Baden. Karlsruhe is the capital. * The Electorate of Baden receives the Electorate of Palatinate. * The Electorate of Hesse emerges from the Landgravate of Hesse-Kassel. Kassel is the capital. * The Principality of Regensburg is established. Regensburg is the capital.
The Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria becomes part of the Austrian Empire.
The Sokoto Caliphate is established.
The French colony of Saint-Domingue on Hispaniola declares its independence from the French Republic as Haiti. Port-au-Prince remains the capital.
The French Republic sells La Louisiane to the United States of America in the Louisiana Purchase. New Orleans (Nouvelle-Orléans) is the capital of the unorganized territory.
The first French Empire supersedes the first French Republic.
Francis II, Holy Roman Emperor, establishes the Austrian Empire. Vienna is the capital.
Jean-Jacques Dessalines establishes the Empire of Haiti.
France annexes the Principality of Piombino and the Republic of Lucca and reconstitutes them as the Principality of Lucca and Piombino.
France annexes the Ligurian Republic.
The Electorate of Bavaria is raised to the Kingdom of Bavaria. Munich is the capital.
The United Kingdom establishes the Cape Colony. Cape Town is the capital.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Kingdom of Holland (Netherlands) supersedes the Batavian Republic.
Napoleon I of France establishes the Confederation of the Rhine. Frankfurt is the capital.
Francis II, Holy Roman Emperor, dissolves the Holy Roman Empire of the German Nation.

links.title: Holy Roman Empire of the German Nation

rows.text: The Grand Duchy of Hesse follows the Landgraviate of Hesse-Darmstadt. Darmstadt is the capital.
The Duchy of Nassau is established as a state of the Confederation of the Rhine. Weilburg and Wiesbaden are the capitals.

The Empire of Haiti collapses upon the assassination of Emperor Jacques I. Haiti splits in two, with the State of Haiti in the north and the Republic of Haiti in the south. The capitals are Milot and Port-au-Prince, respectively.
The Grand Duchy of Baden follows the Electorate of Baden. Karlsruhe is the capital.
The Electorate of Saxony is raised to the Kingdom of Saxony. Dresden is the capital.
Napoleon Bonaparte creates the Duchy of Warsaw from land ceded by the Kingdom of Prussia by the Treaties of Tilsit.
The Free City of Danzig is established as a client state of France.
The Kingdom of Westphalia is established as a client state of France.
France annexes the Kingdom of Etruria.
Spain becomes a client state of the First French Empire after the country is partially occupied by French forces and Joseph I is set as king by Napoleon.
Sierra Leone is established as a crown colony of the United Kingdom. Freetown is the capital.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Kingdom of Italy annexes the Republic of Ragusa.
The Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves removes the capital from Lisbon to exile in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

links.title: Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves

rows.text: Napoleon Bonaparte dissolves the Teutonic Knights; their lands are redistributed between neighboring states of the Holy Roman Empire, mostly to Württemberg.
The United Kingdom occupies the Ionian Islands.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Russian Tsar is declared Grand-duke of Finland, effectively separating Finland from Sweden and turning it into a Russian autonomous duchy.
Sweden officially cedes Finland to Russia through the Peace of Hamina.

The Treaty of Schönbrunn results in the following geopolitical changes: * Salzburg is ceded to the Kingdom of Bavaria. * West Galicia is ceded to the Duchy of Warsaw. * Tarnopol is ceded to the Russian Empire. * Trieste and Croatia south of the Sava are ceded to France; these become the Illyrian provinces.
The Principality of Bayreuth is sold to the Kingdom of Bavaria by France.
The Rhodanic Republic is annexed by France and becomes the département of Simplon.
The Russian Empire annexes the Kingdom of Imereti.
Kamehameha I unifies the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi.
The First Republic of Venezuela is established, starting the Venezuelan War of Independence from Spain.
By the terms of the Treaty of Paris, the Principality of Regensburg is formally incorporated into the Kingdom of Bavaria.

During the May Revolution, the Spanish viceroy in the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata (Argentina, Bolivia, Paraguay, and Uruguay) is replaced by the Primera Junta, and the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata is established. Buenos Aires remains the capital.

links.title: Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata
United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The Kingdom of Holland (Netherlands) is annexed by the First French Empire.
Colombia declares its independence from the Monarchy of Spain.
Mexico declares its independence from the Monarchy of Spain.
Chile installs an autonomous government recognizing the Monarchy of Spain because of the absence of King Ferdinand VII. Santiago is the capital.
The Republic of West Florida declares independence from the Monarchy of Spain.
The United States of America takes control of the Republic of West Florida.
France annexes northern Germany (Hamburg, Bremen, Lübeck, Salm, Arenberg, Oldenburg, parts of Westphalia, and Berg).
The United Kingdom annexes the island of Java.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Kingdom of Haiti supersedes the State of Haiti. Cap-Haïtien is the capital.
Paraguay gains independence from the Monarchy of Spain. Asunción is the capital.
Venezuela declares independence from the Monarchy of Spain.
The United Provinces of New Granada (modern Colombia) are established.
France annexes Catalonia from Spain, creating the départements of Bouches-de-l'Èbre, Montserrat, Sègre, and Ter. Andorra is also annexed and incorporated into the département of Sègre.
The eastern portion of the Principality of Moldavia (Bessarabia) is ceded to the Russian Empire by the Ottoman Empire in the Treaty of Bucharest.
The First Republic of Venezuela is crushed by the Spanish Empire.
The British Malta Colony supersedes the Malta Protectorate.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Second Republic of Venezuela is declared.
Paraguay becomes the Republic of Paraguay.
The Confederation of the Rhine is dissolved.
The Kingdom of Westphalia is dissolved.
The Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands is created from the ruins of the first French Empire. Amsterdam is the capital.

links.title: Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands

rows.text: The Treaty of Valençay formally ends the Peninsular War, restoring Ferdinand VII of Spain and releasing the country from being a client state of the Napoleonic French Empire.
Various Italian states are reinstated, including the Duchy of Modena and Reggio and the Papal States.
The Principality of Andorra declares independence from the First French Empire. Andorra la Vella is the capital.
Java is returned from the United Kingdom to the Netherlands.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands

rows.text: The Kingdom of Norway secedes from Denmark–Norway. Christiania is the capital.
The Netherlands are reestablished from France as the Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands.

links.title: Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands

rows.text: The restored Kingdom of France supersedes the First French Empire.
Napoleon Bonaparte abdicates from the Italian throne, effectively dissolving the Kingdom.
The Kingdom of Sardinia reclaims its mainland territory and annexes the land of the former Republic of Genoa, a move which is ratified by the Congress of Vienna the following year.
Denmark cedes Norway to Sweden through the Peace of Kiel.
The Kingdom of Norway declares full independence, electing its own king and adopting its own constitution.
The Monarchy of Spain reconquers Chile.
The Kingdom of Norway joins a personal union with the Kingdom of Sweden. Stockholm and Christiania are the capitals.
The capital of Bermuda is moved from St George to Hamilton.
The Kandyan Convention disestablishes the Kingdom of Kandy and establishes British Ceylon in Sri Lanka. Colombo is the capital.
The United Kingdom of the Netherlands supersedes the Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands. Amsterdam and Brussels are the joint capitals.

links.title: Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands

rows.text: The first French Empire supersedes the Kingdom of France.

The Congress of Vienna results in the following geopolitical changes: * The Kingdom of Lombardy–Venetia is formed from the Milanese and Venetian portions of the Kingdom of Italy and becomes a crown land of the Austrian Empire. * Austria gains the territory of the former Republic of Ragusa. * The Grand Duchy of Tuscany is re-established and given Piombino. * The Duchy of Lucca is created in place of the former Republic of Lucca. * The Duchy of Warsaw is partitioned into the Grand Duchy of Posen (Prussia), Congress Poland (Russia), and the Free City of Kraków (jointly controlled by Prussia, Russia, and Austria). * The Kingdom of Prussia is awarded Danzig, much of the Kingdom of Saxony, Westphalia, and the Rhineland. * The United Kingdom of the Netherlands is created from the former Dutch Republic and Austrian Netherlands, with Luxembourg in a personal union. * Swedish Pomerania is ceded to Prussia. * Hanover becomes the Kingdom of Hanover and annexes the former territories of the Bishop of Münster and East Frisia. * The Duchy of Lauenburg is ceded by Hanover to Denmark. * The Kingdom of Bavaria gains the Palatinate and parts of the Duchy of Würzburg and Grand Duchy of Frankfurt. * Hesse-Darmstadt gains Rhenish Hesse. * British control of various colonies, including the Cape Colony, Tobago, and Sri Lanka, is recognized. * The United States of the Ionian Islands is formed as a British protectorate. * The German Confederation is established. Frankfurt is the capital.

links.title: United States of the Ionian Islands

rows.text: The Federal League, an alliance of several Argentine Provinces and what is now Uruguay, is established.
The restored Kingdom of France supersedes the first French Empire.
Miloš Obrenović establishes the Principality of Serbia. Kragujevac is the capital.
The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves supersedes the Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves. Rio de Janeiro remains the capital-in-exile.

links.title: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves
Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves

rows.text: Shaka establishes the Zulu Kingdom in southern Africa.
The Kingdom of the Two Sicilies is established from the merger of the Kingdom of Sicily with the Kingdom of Naples. Palermo is the capital.
The Spanish reconquest of New Granada ends the early Colombian independent governments.
The United Provinces in South America (Argentina, Bolivia, and Uruguay) declares its independence from the Monarchy of Spain. Buenos Aires remains the capital.

links.title: United Provinces in South America
links.target: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The capital of the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies is moved from Palermo to Naples.
The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves occupies the Banda Oriental (Uruguay) as Cisplatina.

links.title: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves

rows.text: The State of Chile declares its independence from the Monarchy of Spain. Santiago is the capital.
The Battle of Maipú secures the independence of Chile from Spain.

The Treaty of 1818 sets the 49th parallel north, west of the Lake of the Woods, as the international border between the United States of America and British North America, and also establishes the Oregon Country as a shared region.
The United Provinces of New Granada gains independence from the Monarchy of Spain. Bogotá is the capital.
Gran Colombia is established from the previous Second Republic of Venezuela, United Provinces of New Granada, and the Presidency of Quito.
The Kingdom of Hawaiʻi establishes its capital at Lāhainā.
The Trucial States emerge as a British protectorate.
The Sultanate of Muscat and Oman is established from the merger of the Sultanate of Muscat and the Imamate of Oman.

The Federal League defeats the central government of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata in the Battle of Cepeda. The Federal League is dissolved and the Argentine Provinces resume their individual sovereignties, delegating their representation in foreign affairs to the Province of Buenos Aires.

links.title: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The Kingdom of Haiti collapses upon the suicide of King Henri I. Haiti is unified under the Republic of Haiti with its capital at Port-au-Prince.
The Alaska Boundary Dispute between the Russian Empire and the United Kingdom begins.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Gold Coast is established as a British colony.
In the Adams–Onís Treaty, the United States of America and the Kingdom of Spain define a border between their North American possessions, leading to some land being swapped.
Greece declares its independence from the Ottoman Empire. Nafplion is the capital.
The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves returns the capital from exile in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, to Lisbon.

links.title: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves

rows.text: Spain formally cedes East Florida to the United States of America under the Adams–Onís Treaty.
Spain formally cedes West Florida to the United States of America under the Adams–Onís Treaty.
Cisplatina formally declares itself part of the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves.

links.title: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves

rows.text: Peru declares its independence from the Kingdom of Spain. Lima is the capital.
Peru becomes the State of Peru.
The Monarchy of Spain recognizes the independence of the Mexican Empire.

The Republic of Guatemala, the Republic of Honduras, the Republic of Nicaragua, and the Republic of El Salvador become independent from the Monarchy of Spain. Guatemala City, Comayagua, Managua, and San Salvador are the respective capitals.
The Republic of Costa Rica gains independence from the Monarchy of Spain. Cartago is the capital.
Panama gains independence from the Monarchy of Spain.
Panama unites with Gran Colombia.
The Republic of Spanish Haiti gains independence from the Monarchy of Spain. Santo Domingo is the capital.
Haiti annexes the Republic of Spanish Haiti. Santo Domingo yields to Port-au-Prince as the capital.
The Independent Kingdom of Brazil declares its independence from the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves. Rio de Janeiro is the capital.

links.title: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves

rows.text: The Empire of Brazil supersedes the Independent Kingdom of Brazil.
The Peruvian Republic supersedes the State of Peru.
The Emirate of Afghanistan follows the Durrani Empire. Kabul is the capital.
