The Republic of Costa Rica moves its capital from Cartago to San José.

The Republic of Guatemala, the Republic of El Salvador, the Republic of Nicaragua, the Republic of Honduras, and the Republic of Costa Rica unite to form the Federal Republic of Central America. Guatemala City is the capital.
The United Mexican States supersedes the Mexican Empire upon the execution of Agustín de Iturbide.
The Confederation of the Equator declares independence from the Empire of Brazil. Recife is the capital, but the Confederation capitulates and is reabsorbed later in the year.
Bolivia declares independence from the Monarchy of Spain and refuses to join either Peru or the United Provinces of South America.

links.title: United Provinces of South America
links.target: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The Battle of Ayacucho ends the Spanish American wars of independence in South America.
The Netherlands administratively combines its three colonies of Suriname, Curaçao and Dependencies (the ABC islands), and Sint Eustatius and Dependencies (the SSS islands). The capital is Paramaribo.
The border of the British colony of New South Wales is extended from 133°E to 129°E.
The Bolivian Republic gains independence from the Monarchy of Spain at the conclusion of the Bolivian War of Independence. Chuquisaca (later Sucre) is the capital.
Cisplatina declares its independence from the Empire of Brazil and reunites with the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata.

links.title: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves recognizes the independence of the Empire of Brazil.

links.title: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves

rows.text: The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves changes its name back to the Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves.

links.title: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves
Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves

rows.text: Van Diemen's Land is declared a separate British colony to New South Wales.
British Malaya is established and managed by the British East India Company.
Following the First Anglo-Burmese War, Burma is forced to cede Assam, Manipur, Arakan, and Tenasserim to the British East India Company.
The Duchy of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha is created from the merger of the Duchies of Saxe-Coburg and Saxe-Gotha. Coburg and Gotha are the respective capitals.
The United Provinces of the Río de la Plata is proclaimed as a centralist and unitary state.

links.title: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The Republic of Chile supersedes the State of Chile.
The Straits Settlements administrative unit is established and managed by the British East India Company. It consists of Penang, Dinding, Malacca, and Singapore.
The United Kingdom claims the Bonin Islands.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The centralist and unitary state of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata is dissolved. The Argentine Provinces resume their individual sovereignties, delegating their representation in foreign affairs to the Province of Buenos Aires.

links.title: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The Kingdom of Vientiane is annexed by Siam.
The Banda Oriental gains independence from the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata as the Government and Provisional General Captaincy of the Oriental State of Uruguay. Montevideo is the capital.

links.title: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The Misiones Orientales are awarded to the Empire of Brazil.
The British Swan River Colony is established in western Australia.
France conquers the Regency of Algiers from the Ottoman Empire.
The Ottoman Empire recognizes the independence of the First Hellenic Republic. Nafplio is the capital.
The Republic of Ecuador and the Republic of Venezuela declare independence from Gran Colombia. Quito and Caracas are the respective capitals.
The Oriental State of Uruguay is created from the Government and Provisional General Captaincy of the Oriental State of Uruguay.
The Unitarian League is created among the Argentine provinces of San Luis, La Rioja, Catamarca, Mendoza, San Juan, Tucumán, Córdoba, Salta, and Santiago del Estero.
Belgium declares its independence from the United Kingdom of the Netherlands. Brussels is the capital.
The United Kingdom combines Essequibo-Demerara and Berbice as the Crown Colony of British Guiana. Georgetown is the capital.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Federal Pact is signed by the Province of Buenos Aires, the Province of Entre Ríos, and the Province of Santa Fe, beginning the Argentine Confederation.
Belgium becomes the Kingdom of Belgium.
The Province of Mendoza joins the Federal Pact.
The Province of Corrientes joins the Federal Pact.
The Province of Córdoba and the Province of Santiago del Estero join the Federal Pact.
The Province of La Rioja joins the Federal Pact.
The Republic of New Granada supersedes Gran Colombia.
The colony of Western Australia supersedes the British Swan River Colony in Australia.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Province of San Luis joins the Federal Pact.
The Kingdom of Greece supersedes the First Hellenic Republic.
The Province of San Juan joins the Federal Pact.
The Province of Salta joins the Federal Pact.
The Province of Tucumán joins the Federal Pact.
The Republic of Indian Stream declares independence from both the United States of America and the United Kingdom, as it was disputed territory.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Province of Catamarca joins the Federal Pact. End of the Unitarian League.
The Falkland Islands become a colony of the United Kingdom. Port Louis is the capital.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The United Kingdom removes a garrison installed by the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata in October 1832, thereby reasserting its claim to sovereignty over the Falkland Islands. Port Louis becomes the capital.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
Reassertion of British sovereignty over the Falkland Islands (1833)
United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

rows.text: The Republic of Maryland is established. Harper is the capital.
The Federal Republic of Central America moves its capital from Guatemala City to San Salvador.
The Kingdom of Greece moves its capital from Nafplio to Athens.
The Republic of Indian Stream is annexed by the United States of America.
The Mexican Republic supersedes the United Mexican States.
James Busby and 34 northern Māori chiefs sign He Whakaputanga resulting in the creation of the United Tribes of New Zealand. Its capital was Waitangi.
The Republic of Texas declares its independence from Mexico. Washington-on-the-Brazos is the first of six cities that will serve as the temporary capital until 1839.
The Republic of South Peru secedes from the Peruvian Republic. Cusco is the capital.
The Republic of North Peru supersedes the Peruvian Republic.
The Riograndense Republic declares independence from Brazil. Piratini is the first of five provisional capitals.
The Republic of North Peru, the Republic of South Peru, and the Bolivian Republic unite to form the Peru-Bolivian Confederation. Tacna is the capital.
The colony of South Australia is separated from the British colony of New South Wales.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Republic of Costa Rica, the Republic of Nicaragua, and the Republic of Honduras secede from the Federal Republic of Central America. San José, Managua, and Comayagua are the respective capitals.
The United Kingdom annexes Pitcairn Island.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Principality of Serbia moves its capital from Kragujevac to Belgrade.
Chile and Peruvian dissidents win decisevly the Battle of Yungay against the Peru–Bolivian Confederation, starting the fall of the union.
The Grand Duchy of Luxembourg becomes independent, but remains in personal union with the Netherlands as a result of the Treaty of London.
The Juliana Republic declares independence from Brazil. Laguna is the capital. The Republic capitulates and is reabsorbed later in the year.
The Peruvian Republic and the Bolivian Republic are formed from the dissolution of the Peru-Bolivian Confederation. Lima and Sucre (previously Chuquisaca) are the respective capitals.
The Republic of Texas establishes its permanent capital at Austin.
The Republic of Guatemala secedes from the Federal Republic of Central America. Guatemala City is the capital.
The Treaty of Waitangi is signed resulting in the disestablishment of the United Tribes of New Zealand.
The colony of New Zealand is separated from the British colony of New South Wales.
The United Kingdom conquers Hong Kong Island from the Qing dynasty.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The sole remnant of the Federal Republic of Central America changes its name back to the Republic of El Salvador.
The United Kingdom unites Upper Canada and Lower Canada as the Crown Colony of the United Province of Canada. Kingston is the capital.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: James Brooke establishes the Kingdom of Sarawak. Kuching is the capital.
The Republic of Yucatán declares itself independent from Mexico. Mérida is the capital.
The Webster–Ashburton Treaty comes into effect, ending several border disputes between the United States of America and the United Kingdom.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The United Kingdom moves the capital of the Crown Colony of the United Province of Canada from Kingston to Montréal.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Dominican Republic gains independence from Haiti. Santo Domingo is the capital.

The Netherlands splits its colonial possessions in the Americas into two parts: Suriname and Curaçao and Dependencies. Paramaribo remains the capital of Suriname, while Willemstad on Curaçao becomes the capital of the six Caribbean islands.
The Kingdom of Hawaiʻi moves its capital from Lāhainā to Honolulu.
The United Kingdom moves the capital of the Falkland Islands from Port Louis to Stanley.

links.title: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

rows.text: The Riograndense Republic is reabsorbed by the Brazilian Empire as the province of Rio Grande do Sul again.
The Republic of Texas joins the United States of America as the State of Texas. Austin yields to Washington as federal capital while remaining capital of the state.
The princely state of Kashmir and Jammu, ruled by the Dogra Dynasty, is created after the First Anglo-Sikh War, as per the Treaty of Amritsar.
The colony of North Australia is separated from the British colony of New South Wales.
The Oregon Treaty establishes the 49th parallel north, from west of the Lake of the Woods, as the continental border between the Province of Canada and the United States of America.
The United Mexican States supersedes the Mexican Republic.
After the Kraków Uprising, the Free City of Cracow is annexed by the Austrian Empire.
The British colony of North Australia is reincorporated back into the colony of New South Wales.
The African-American colony of Liberia declares its independence as the Republic of Liberia. Monrovia is the capital.
French Algeria is made an integral part of France.
The Kazakh Khanate loses its sovereignty to the Russian Empire.
The Mexican–American War ends with the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo, by which the United Mexican States cedes all of its northernmost territories to the United States of America.
The Second French Republic supersedes the Kingdom of France.
The Grand Duchy of Posen is fully incorporated into the Kingdom of Prussia and becomes the Province of Posen.
